title: Universal Context Intelligence — the reference frame every context resolves in
authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH, HELD SUBORDINATE UNDER UCKP-LAW-0001. This declaration recognises an implementation that already exists at engine/context/. It creates no authority, transfers no ownership, and adds no capability.

constitutional_superior.effect: UCKP-ART-04 is the article CXL-10 is true under — representations hold no independent authority, and context describes without ever granting. UCKP-ART-13 is why a context's identity is a pure function of its identity tuple and why every derived artefact carries a reproducible seal (CXL-05, CXL-09). UCKP-ART-07 is named because this register declares eleven context RELATIONS, and each projects the relationship model declared there — this register does not own what a relationship IS.

implementation.$note: Each law carries a check that computes its own compliance from the registry, the graph and where relevant a composition. A law with no reachable check would be manual governance, so the constitution refuses to construct itself if any law is unchecked.

bounded_question: In which reference frame does a context resolve, what kind of context is it, and how is a kind nobody has declared yet admitted?
owns: context reference frames — CXL-03, every context bound to exactly one frame; CXL-04, no reference crosses a frame boundary without an explicit federation
the context taxonomy — the open classification tree over context kinds
the context extension mechanism — CXL-02, a future context type admitted as data, never invented at a call site
context binding resolution — the frame and resolution digest a consumer binds to
does_not_own: entity existence — UCOS-CEU-001. This register describes the frame a unit exists in; it never decides that the unit exists.
the relationship semantic model — UCKP-ART-07 at engine/uckp/graph.py. The eleven declared context relations are instances projecting that model.
permission — CXL-10 Zero Authority: context describes; it never grants. Observation is not permission.
governance decisions — CEP-002 Article 28 and UCDA-000001.

openness.extension_mechanism: ContextTaxonomy.extend — admits a future context type and returns a new taxonomy; a DATA edit, not a code edit
openness.$current_kinds_are_examples_not_a_bounda: The kinds recognised today — existence, reality, spatial, temporal, observer, identity, knowledge, linguistic, cultural, economic, governance, security, computational, environmental, regulatory — are the contexts this platform has needed so far. They are not a closed list, and no consumer branches on a particular kind.
openness.$declared_future_path: A measurement context is a recognised future declaration path and enters through CXL-02 like any other kind: as data, with no redesign of this register or its laws.

invariants: Every context resolves in exactly one frame (CXL-03).
A context kind is admitted by declaration, never invented at a call site (CXL-02).
A context's identity is a pure function of its identity tuple, minted by the single registration authority (CXL-05).
